utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tools and pickup times are still open as far as I know; I can lock both down today if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That helps, but can you confirm today whether the repair drive is definitely happening this weekend before we start counting on pickups?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah—I’ll confirm today whether it’s definitely on this weekend, then I’ll lock in pickups right after.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m mostly worried about the timing and tool overlap, so I’m waiting on Gus’s list before I tell anyone what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That makes sense—once Gus’s list is in, I can help spread a clear ask to a few different groups so people don’t all bring the same things.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot—if we can keep it to a simple list with time slots, I think people will be much more willing to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mara, the repair drive is set up in the community room at Maple Court, right by the front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Rosa—I’ll head there and start with the bikes first, then the fence by the garden.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Mara—thank you; I’ll keep checking the list here so we don’t miss any houses.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do you know the current sign-up count, and are the porch steps and shed patching already covered with materials?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I don’t know the sign-up count offhand, sorry—I just remember I’m supposed to bring my toolbox and spare screws to the community shed at ten.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright—if you’re bringing the toolbox and screws for the shed, who told you that, and do you know who’s actually leading the porch steps work?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’m still out on errands, but keep me posted on the repair drive tonight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do—I’m still spreading the word, and I’ll pass the repair drive’s day and time along tonight as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik—I appreciate you spreading the word. Just send me the day and time tonight when you hear it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We’re making some progress, Tess, just not as fast as I’d hoped. If you can spare an hour, we could use another steady pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can spare an hour, and I’ve also heard it’s still on for this weekend—they’re just waiting on one last confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds right—if that last piece comes through, we can keep it on track for the weekend. Thank you, Tess; an extra hour helps more than you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only got the second-hand version still—last I heard it was the porch steps, the alley fence, and shed patching, but I’d want Eli to confirm who’s actually got each part.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds about right to start with; let’s write down porch steps, alley fence, and shed patching, then confirm which house each job belongs to before we ask for help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that makes sense—I’d rather note the jobs first and then get someone to confirm which place each one belongs to before I repeat it around.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, let’s just do a quick run through Maple Street first and make sure every house is on there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll bring my toolbox along, and I’ll text over what’s in it tonight so we don’t double up for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just skim me the list too when you send it, and we’ll keep Maple Street covered for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say anything, I want to double-check the sign-up sheet and confirm whether tools and pickup times are still open.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, good call—I'm running a little late, but as far as I know tools and pickup times are still open, so check the sheet and we’ll start with the bikes and that loose garden fence.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane—I’ll confirm the sign-up count first, and if tools and pickup times are still open after that, we can start with the bikes and the loose fence.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Opal, I’ve got us low on tarps and probably work gloves, and we still need to sort out tape, extension cords, and cleaning rags before the next pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive marked at the community room at Maple Court, right by the front entrance. I can pass that along while we track down the tarps and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—that helps a lot. I’ll keep the supply list focused on tarps, work gloves, tape, extension cords, and cleaning rags until we confirm what’s already on hand.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can still help with the repair drive, as long as we keep me clear of 7:30–8:30 and 2:30–3:30 for school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that should still help a lot—I think they were looking for a couple more volunteers, but Cleo probably has the clearest update.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Good to know—if Cleo still needs another pair of hands, I can take a shift between those school windows.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam, we’ve got a repair drive this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed—come by if you can, and feel free to spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in—I can bring my drill, socket set, and extension cords, and I’m free Saturday from 9 to 1, so put me where I’m most useful.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be amazing, Sam—you’d be a huge help getting setup and handling tool-heavy fixes from 9 to 1. Bring whoever else might want to pitch in, too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tess, I’ve got us marked low on tarps and probably work gloves, and we still need to sort tape, extension cords, and cleaning rags.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Cleo—I’ve still only heard it’s likely on for this weekend and waiting on that last confirmation, but I’ll pass along that tarps, gloves, tape, extension cords, and rags are what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—once that weekend confirmation comes through, let me know if anyone can verify what we already have on the nails and cords so I can update the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Opal — I’m still out on errands, but please keep me posted on how the repair drive’s coming along tonight.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do—I've got it marked at the community room in Maple Court, right by the front entrance, so I’ll let you know how it’s going tonight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks, Opal—I appreciate you keeping an eye on it while I’m out, so just send me a quick update tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you double-check who’s on the porch steps and the shed patching, and whether the materials are already lined up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can’t confirm that part, sorry—I only heard Jonah had the fence and Bea was gathering tools, so I’d want to check with Mara before saying who’s on the steps or shed or whether the materials are all there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, check with Mara and get back to me on the porch steps, shed patching, and whether the materials are already covered.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve only heard bits so far, but if it’s mostly small fixes and there’s a clear list, I can help ask around and maybe take on a simple job.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Rey—I’m texting the tool list tonight, and I can bring my toolbox and spare drill on Saturday if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that helps—send me the list when you can, and I’ll see who might be good for the railings or plumbing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, the repair drive’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed—can you come, and maybe help spread the word too?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I’ll be there at ten and I can help get the word around a little.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, thanks Uli—I’m telling folks you’re in, and if you hear of anyone who likes fixing things, send them by the Maple Street garden shed on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take a repair drive shift between those windows if that works for Eli, just not during drop-off or pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works fine for me, Faye—once we have the day and time, I’ll make a simple list of the jobs and we can fit your shift around those windows.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Eli—I’m free between 8:30 and 2:30, so just send me the day and I’ll make it work.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right—community shed at ten, and I’ll bring the toolbox and some spare screws if I can find them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect—I’ll be there Saturday from 9 to 1 with my drill, socket set, and extension cords, so just point me at whatever needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam—I’ll head to the community shed at ten with the toolbox and whatever screws I can dig up, and we’ll see what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I tell Pia anything firm, I want to check the sign-up sheet and confirm whether Leo has already taken care of the tools and pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana—that’s exactly what I was worried about, so let me know once you’ve confirmed the sign-up sheet and pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely—I’ll check the sign-up sheet and confirm with Leo about the tools and pickup times, then I’ll update you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Bo—let’s kick off with the busted bikes first, then the loose fence by the garden.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that works—let’s hit the bikes first, then the fence, and keep moving down the list so we don’t miss any houses.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I'll jump in on the bikes now and we can head to the fence right after.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, yeah, last I heard it was basic tools, tarps, and maybe work gloves, plus a couple more volunteers—but I could be behind, so Cleo probably has the best list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That matches what I’ve been hearing too—I’m already reaching out to a few folks from different circles, and I can point people to Cleo for the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good—thanks, Jules. If I hear anything more solid, I’ll send people Cleo’s way so I don’t muddle the list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Leo, Dane wants us starting with the busted bikes first, then the loose fence by the garden, and I’m working Faye in between her school runs.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—let’s lock bikes first, fence after, and I’ll sort the tool list and pickup times today so Faye can slot in cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo—that keeps us on Dane’s plan, and once you’ve got the tool list and times, I’ll line Faye up for the window she can make.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Rosa, do we have that last confirmation yet, or is the repair drive still only tentative for this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s confirmed now, Kira—the repair drive is set up in the community room at Maple Court, right by the front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, and that’s definitely locked in for this weekend at Maple Court, right?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
